claim: For the real Day--James plane \(X=\ell_2-\ell_\infty\), with \(\|(u,v)\|_{2,\infty}=\sqrt{u^2+v^2}\) when \(uv\ge0\) and \(\|(u,v)\|_{2,\infty}=\max\{|u|,|v|\}\) when \(uv\le0\), the Ptolemy constant is exactly \(C_{\mathrm{Pt}}(X)=3/2\).

correctness.rationale: The proof checks both sign branches exactly and proves \(H\le\|\cdot\|_{2,\infty}\le\sqrt{3/2}\,H\) for the positive-definite Hilbert norm \(H(u,v)=\frac12\sqrt{3u^2+2uv+3v^2}\). Hilbert Ptolemy then gives \(C_{\mathrm{Pt}}\le3/2\), while the explicit admissible triple \((-1,-1),(2,-2),(1,-3)\) has Ptolemy ratio exactly \(3/2\).
